nodes.title: ADR 0046: Own production release deployment in Orbit

description:
An authorized client receives deployment progress and application output as it happens and can distinguish a completed operation from an interrupted stream.

## Scope

* In: synchronous deploy and rollback HTTP endpoints, bounded NDJSON event transport, runtime-state inspection, authorization, and sanitized Activity.
* Out: asynchronous jobs, reconnect or replay, persisted logs, deployment history, SDK, and CLI.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `POST /instances/{instance}/deploy` accepts an empty JSON object and `POST /instances/{instance}/rollback` accepts only `release`; invalid requests and access refusals use the ordinary JSON error envelope before opening a stream. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/AppInstanceDeploymentsTest.php`.
- [ ] Successful admission returns `application/x-ndjson`; every event has `type`, monotonically increasing `sequence`, and `request_id`. Event types are `phase` with `phase` and optional `step_name`, `output` with `stream` (`stdout` or `stderr`) and `data_base64`, and terminal `result` with `status`, nullable `failed_step`, nullable `error_code`, and nullable `selected_release`. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/DeploymentStreamTest.php`.
- [ ] Output chunks contain at most 16 KiB decoded bytes and event lines at most 32 KiB; phase values identify source preparation, environment sync, pre-activation steps, activation, PHP refresh, post-activation steps, or rollback, and output reaches the caller before the command exits. Proof: Incus action `deployment-http-stream`.
- [ ] Exactly one terminal result ends a connected invocation; execution failure after stream admission produces a failed result instead of an incompatible second HTTP envelope, while a disconnected stream makes no success claim and has no automatic replay. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/DeploymentStreamTest.php`.
- [ ] Transport disconnect signals cancellation to the active invocation and bounded process cleanup, without an automatic code rollback; `GET /instances/{instance}/releases` returns only present retained release names and the current selection for explicit inspection after interruption, with no deployment history. Proof: Incus action `deployment-http-disconnect`.
- [ ] Only a caller with access to the target Node receives application output; Activity and generic errors contain only bounded identifiers and outcomes, and Gateway/proxy buffering and request limits permit the action’s bounded execution budget. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/AppInstanceDeploymentsTest.php` and Incus action `deployment-http-stream`.
- [ ] Maintained documentation describes HTTP stream fields, limits, terminal results, disconnects, and current-release inspection, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Changed project checks and repository suites pass. Proof: `cd apps/gateway && composer check`, and all five full no-TIA CI suites on the submitted candidate, plus focused affected Pest tests locally.
title: Stream deployment results through the Gateway API
